title: Snap-Shut Fence Latch – Easy-to-Install Gate Latch for Pasture & Paddock
descriptionHtml:
A fiddly gate the animals learn to open?

A bad gate latch rattles, sticks and – worst of all – can be opened by curious animals. Chasing loose animals across your land is the last thing you want to be doing on a morning.

A secure gate – open and close with one hand

The latch snaps shut automatically and keeps the gate firmly closed, while you can open it easily with one hand. Easy to install on most pasture and paddock fences, built to last in all weather.

Features

  • Self-closing – the gate locks itself.
  • Animal-proof – keeps horses, sheep and goats in.
  • One-hand opening – handy when your arms are full.
  • Stands up to wind and weather – for outdoor use all year round.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
